ecosystem_completion_slices.purpose: Expand RFC-0108 into a governed ecosystem observability contract and per-app gap matrix before runtime work resumes.
Make uniform observability the platform default through scaffolding and CI enforcement.

Implement backend freshness, data-quality, and supportability signals in participating services; lotus-core portfolio readiness supportability, lotus-risk risk/calculate, lotus-performance TWR, lotus-advise advisory supportability, lotus-manage action-register supportability, lotus-report evidence-surface supportability, lotus-render render supportability, lotus-archive archive supportability, and lotus-ai AI surface supportability are implemented, while remaining performance/risk endpoint families and Gateway/Workbench reconciliation stay planned.

Partially complete Gateway fan-out metrics and protected diagnostics for selected Workbench performance and risk analytics fan-out plus central manage, report, archive, and AI client seams while remaining direct core-query paths stay planned.
required_proof: all-path rollout proof before full completion

ecosystem_completion_slices.purpose: Roll observability out to every supported Workbench surface.
Extend dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and operator diagnostics across implemented ecosystem telemetry.
Prove the complete supported Lotus user journey end to end.
Perform ecosystem hardening, API certification, and no-open-P0/P1 review.
Close RFC-0108 after uniform ecosystem observability is implemented and published.
